t: This is Well Walk, a street in Hampstead that runs southwest from the edge of Hampstead Heath towards Flask Walk. It takes its name from the historic Hampstead Wells. Several people with interesting lives are connected to it. Julia Stephen, mother of Virginia Woolf and Vanessa Bell, lived here. The socialist writer and politician Henry Hyndman died here, and so did Rosalind Travers Hyndman, a poet, suffragist and socialist.
